#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=29131 SECS=115 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_ride mp_carentan +set probe_teleport 1
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:29131 --probe-ride --probe-team allies --probe-secs 104

# entity, between half a second before the first phase and half a second past the last.
